Name: Rubber Bones
Description:
You touch a creature. Its bones become soft and rubbery, and it gains the following benefits:

• It can expend 5 feet of movement to escape a grapple without requiring an ability check and can squeeze through a space that is large enough for a creature two sizes smaller than it.
• It has advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
• It has resistance to bludgeoning damage.
• Its range with melee attacks increases by 5 feet.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.
Sourcebook: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt
